selectionNote: Selected 14 guided Cabo San Lucas d50859 products with live public USD From prices, combined ratings, and unique 674x446 heroes. The live catalog supports far more than 20 tours, including preferred jeep, e-bike, horseback, photography, and additional ATV SKUs, but Viator DataDome blocking plus geo-currency dumps (EUR/CAD/GBP/AUD/SGD) blocked many otherwise-strong pages from being verified in USD on a complete product page. No live d50859 helicopter page with combined USD+rating+hero was captured. Did not force audio/self-guided/app tours, airport transfers, inactive products, thin-review SKUs, near-duplicates, park-pass tickets, or products with unusable heroes. Same completeness constraint documented on Puerto Vallarta (10), Cancun (13), and Mexico City (11).
